items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Then we formed a little band around in New Orleans called the Rozeal's Band.

ctx.x: No. We learned string bass, any string bass player, any kind of string bass can play a little bit guitar. And any good guitar player can play string bass. Because you've got four strings on there, it's the same as string bass. Then we formed a little band around in New Orleans called the Rozeal's Band. And Roy Palmer-

See Roy Palmer was first a guitar player where we had a little three piece band, see. Then we converted Roy to trumpet player, see. And we had Joe Johnson on guitar. My brother had an E flat trumpet and trumpet players used to use an E flat trumpet around and brass bands. So Joe kept a fool with his E flat trumpet and learned how to play trumpet. And he had a guy that called the trumpet player, Ovit, Ovit Jackson, that's really Ovit, you know that's French, you know that. See he didn't make it on trumpet, so Roy…
